answer: The violet index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the bridge queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 646 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the wharf. A 417 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
